translated_title: Mexico’s Labor Ministry Confirms US Company Newmont Violated Workers’ Rights at the Peñasquito Gold Mine
original_title: STPS confirma que empresa Newmont de EU violó derechos de trabajadores de la mina de oro Peñasquito
author: Jared Laureles and Jessica Xantomila
meta_description: The miners’ union’s fifth USMCA rapid-response case forces Newmont into a neutrality letter and a binational remediation plan after three leaders were fired.
